brief:
Israeli occupation forces resumed military operations across Gaza on Saturday morning, the Shehab Wire reported, violating the ceasefire agreement through sustained artillery strikes and gunfire from military vehicles. Helicopter gunships and naval gunboats also participated in the renewed assault, targeting multiple locations scattered throughout the territory.

The violations marked a continuation of hostilities despite the implementation of the ceasefire accord. The resumed bombardment included fire from various military platforms—ground-based artillery and armored vehicles alongside airborne and naval assets—striking populated areas across the strip without apparent coordination with ceasefire terms.

title: Israeli forces resume Gaza bombardment despite ceasefire
